findings.evidence: Merged UX workflows used mutable refs such as actions/checkout@v4 and actions/upload-artifact@v4 while newer security workflows already use immutable commit SHAs.
findings.cause: CI dependency references were not governed by a repository-wide immutable-ref rule.
findings.prevention: Pin merged workflows and fail future pushes containing mutable external action refs.

findings.evidence: Railway deployment 2d399257-e7ea-43e8-a728-d563e8cb366b was created 2026-09-17T16:20:31Z; current main 02d364e82bdb7699e0f91a47aa4a0f941b89ad2f merged at 2026-09-17T22:34:38Z after identity-survival and UX wrapper changes.
findings.cause: Canonical deployment provenance is decoupled from repository/isolated-proof progress.
findings.prevention: Do not claim canonical staging is current until a newer deployment is rebound to the expected immutable runtime/wrapper inputs and hosted proof passes.

findings.evidence: Railway watches Dockerfile, DEPLOYMENT_MANIFEST.json, STAGING_FREEZE.json and artifact/**; Dockerfile also copies security/runtime/** and ux-overlay/**.
findings.cause: Source-watch configuration does not enumerate all deployment-sensitive build inputs.
findings.prevention: Require security/runtime/** and ux-overlay/** in Railway watch patterns before relying on automatic source-linked deployment.

findings.evidence: Railway reports WFM_STAGING_PASSWORD and Wfm_staging_password. Values were redacted and not inspected.
findings.cause: Credential configuration contains a case-variant alias.
findings.prevention: After dependent workflow verification, remove the obsolete alias only through an explicitly approved staging configuration change.
